realizes.rationale: The bound, its default, its scope and its refusal are documented where settings are documented.
The role-working-folder reference explains real leaf copies, controller canonical paths and file reading; it is documentation of the selected route.
Installation instructions name the required user-file upgrade and path refusals without directing agents to edit the developer real settings file.
The section a user reads: why the file is closed, the command before an edit, the command that closes both again, and where the product names an open file.
The settings reference names the active MCP host authority and preserves the single user role-settings boundary.

This reference documents the extra-argument keys, where they are allowed and what a role entry set to false removes: presentation and support of the documented key. The runtime enforcement stays with the settings parser, the defaults assembly and the launch plan, which are separate links.

The reference maps accepted settings keys individually. spawn.harness has actual role-default/terminal readers; concurrency is explicitly unenforced, while qualityGate resource policy is a separately described key whose enforcement cannot be inferred merely from this document.
